description: This Java class 'TbRuleEngineConsumerStats' manages and logs statistics related to rule engine message processing, including counters for messages, iterations, and exceptions, as well as tenant-specific stats and timers.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineConsumerStats
classes.description: A class for collecting, managing, and logging statistics related to rule engine message processing, including message counts, success/failure metrics, tenant-specific stats, and timing information.

methods.name: TbRuleEngineConsumerStats
methods.description: Constructor initializing counters and timers based on queue key and stats factory.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Returns or creates a timer for a specific tenant ID and status.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs processing results, updating counters and tenant stats based on message success, failure, timeout, and exceptions.

methods.name: getTenantStats
methods.description: Retrieves or creates tenant-specific rule engine stats based on message metadata.

methods.name: getQueueName
methods.description: Returns the name of the queue associated with this stats object.

methods.name: getTenantExceptions
methods.description: Returns the map of tenant exceptions encountered during processing.

methods.name: printStats
methods.description: Outputs current statistics to logs if message count is greater than zero.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all counters, tenant stats, and exceptions, resetting the object state.
